name: Sweet Keeper
author: VampX
description:
Sweet Keeper is a Pixel 2D Top Down Action Game. In Sweet Keeper you play as a slime and you compete against a variety of enemies while trying to collect as much sweets as possible. The game is filled with lots of enemies, obstacles, sweets of course and much more.
Controls: WASD, or Arrow keys. Space to Dash
For more games, Join the Official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/zk4fWmjX
